Atomic activation and idempotence passed; explicit rollback, DB migration compatibility and uninstall preservation remain unverified.
Actual arm64 GUI and isolated profile passed; Windows registry external-clip discovery still logs an error and multi-profile concurrency is not verified.
Real worker migrations, JSONB CRUD and close/reopen passed; deliberate corruption and CLI recovery remain unverified.
Both client Velopack entry points and SQLite addon download fallback are controlled; recorder AssetManager and release-cleared self-contained tools remain open.
Selected-port/authentication/bidirectional subset passed; heartbeat, reconnect, malformed/oversized frames, duplicate in-flight IDs and slow-handler coverage remain.
Normal shutdown and parent death passed; capture denial/failure, restart bounds and pending-export recovery are not implemented.
Recovered outward DTO shapes and typed settings transport passed; persistent stable-ID mapping, duplicate-label selection, hotplug and live capture reconfiguration remain.
ScreenCaptureKit source enumeration, picker and direct VideoToolbox feed compile, but no TCC-authorized display/window/application capture has run yet.
The namespaced actual-client control surface is a test integration; the normal renderer source-selection UI is not implemented yet.
Stable team-backed Medal/recorder development identities, the imported Medal icon and usage descriptions are verified; no TCC prompt, denial, revocation or regrant test has run yet.
This is local Apple Development signing, not Developer ID distribution, notarization or release packaging.
The backend requires hardware H.264 creation and verifies UsingHardwareAcceleratedVideoEncoder, but has not encoded a TCC-authorized real frame yet.
AAC is not implemented yet, so no real H.264/AAC file is claimed.
Bounded generation-aware encoded packet storage is unit-tested; no real encoder packets or container export have been connected.
